title: Te Atarangi i Muri i te Torona
intro: Kei roto koe i ngā marae o tētahi kingitanga tawhito nui, i reira tētahi rangatira kaha kua kī ko ia te atua mō te iwi katoa. I te taha o tēnei rangatira e tū ana tētahi pononga pono, kua tukua ki a ia ngā wawata nui o te kingitanga. Ka mahi tahi rātou i ngā mahere, ka whakarōpū, ka whakakāhore i te whakarongo ki ngā whakatūpato a tētahi karere i tonoa hei ārahi i a rātou. Ka taea e koe te hura ko wai tēnei pononga pono?
clues: I noho ahau i roto i tētahi kingitanga nui e whakahaerehia ana e tētahi tangata whai mana nui, ā, i kī ia ko ia te atua o te iwi katoa.
I mahi ahau hei minita pono mā tēnei rangatira, e whakatutuki ana i ā rātou wawata me ā rātou whakahau katoa.
I te taenga mai o te karere a Allah ki tō mātou whenua e karanga ana i a mātou ki te pono, kāore māua ko tōku rangatira i pai ki te whakarongo.
I whakahaua ahau kia tahuna he ahi nui, kia whakarite hoki i ngā pereki paru mō tētahi hanganga nui.
I hiahia taku rangatira ki te whakatū i tētahi whare tiketike rawa kia eke ki ngā rangi.
I te mutunga, ko taku rangatira, ko ā mātou ope taua, ko ahau anō hoki i kahakina atu, ā, i toremi ki te hohonutanga o te moana.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
